changeRecord.title: rigid link / diaphragm removed
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A rigid diaphragm or link is a kinematic assumption that decides how lateral load is shared: with it the connected nodes move as one rigid body and the load goes to the frames in proportion to their stiffness and position; without it each node moves on its own and the load follows the members. Removing it frees the slaves from the master: storey forces applied at the master no longer reach the frame (a master without members is then a loaded node with no stiffness -- a mechanism), or the floor racks and twists instead of moving rigidly.
changeRecord.precondition: the model has at least one rigid constraint (rigidLink or rigidDiaphragm)
